summary: Fabric pairing accepts new and legacy adapter executable and environment names, refusing conflicting environment overrides.

rules.detail: Pairing trust and authorization are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Discovery accepts FRACTAL_FABRIC_ADAPTER then ST_FABRIC_ADAPTER. Different paths in both variables are an error. Otherwise it searches beside the executable then each PATH directory, preferring fractal-fabric-adapter over st-fabric-adapter within each directory. The produced binary remains st-fabric-adapter.

manual.detail: Existing installations continue working. If both overrides are set, use the same path or unset one.

recovery.detail: Rollback retains support for the legacy executable and environment variable.
